subject: Log retention, BYOK & audit parity — sprint scoping and exceptions
messages:
From: Mallory Chen <secops@clearhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Audit logs + BYOK for POC (retention requirements)

Hi Naomi / Ben,

Quick intro — I'm Mallory on ClearHealth's security team. We're preparing a short POC (3 months) that will ingest limited PHI-derived metadata. Our compliance team has two non-negotiable asks for the POC to proceed:

1) Audit logs: immutable, tamper-evident audit trail with export capability. We need event-level logs for all API calls and admin actions.
2) Key custody (BYOK): ability to supply a customer-managed key (bring-your-own-key) with the option for us to escrow the key offsite at the end of the engagement.

Retention: compliance wants a configurable retention window; baseline ask is 5 years for audit records, with a short-term retention mode for debug data (90 days).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Surface a full audit export (CSV/NDJSON) on-demand, and
- Support a BYOK flow for POCs (either key upload or integration with our KMS), and
- Provide evidence artifacts (signed hashes or export receipts) to satisfy our auditors?

I've attached our questionnaire (ClearHealth_compliance_q.pdf) to make the asks concrete. If these are possible, we'd like to map to a mutual action plan and commercial milestone. Otherwise we need to understand gaps so we can scope alternatives.

Thanks,
Mallory Chen
Senior Security Engineer
ClearHealth

Attachment: ClearHealth_compliance_q.pdf

Thanks Naomi — quick thoughts from product prioritization POV:

Minimum viable slice for POC (2 weeks):
- Export: on-demand audit export (NDJSON) from a read-only admin console endpoint. No UI polish.
- Retention knobs: two presets (90d, 5y) configurable per-account via API. Underneath this can be a soft-delete + export before purge.
- Evidence: signed export manifest (SHA256 + timestamp) that we can hand them.

Non-MVP but useful: continuous immutable ledger (append-only block) and native escrow workflow for keys. Those are spikes / larger sprints.

If infra can confirm that BYOK for POC can be done as a KMS integration (we do not take raw key material into Redwood custody), we can proceed with a MAP that layers in the heavy crypto later.

I'm happy to scope a product ticket for the MVP slice and add acceptance criteria.

-Jonas
Director of Product (Security)

Subject: Re: Fwd: Audit logs + BYOK for POC (retention requirements) — infra feasibility notes

Short summary from infra/security:
- BYOK modes: we support two integration patterns today — (A) KMS link (customer-managed key in their KMS; we call via IAM role) and (B) ephemeral key upload (for short POCs) but we do not recommend long-term custody of raw keys. Option B requires a 1–2 sprint work to add secure key wipe and HSM-assisted sealing.
- Retention: implementing retention presets backed by soft-delete + timed purge is straightforward; the challenge is preserving an immutable audit export before purging (we can add export hooks).
- Evidence: we can sign exports with a Redwood HSM-backed signing key and supply the manifest. If customer demands customer-controlled signing, that becomes the escrow flow (more complex).

I've attached a short feasibility note (kms-feasibility-notes.md) with blockers and an estimated timeline:
- MVP export + retention presets: 2 sprints (2 engineers, infra support)
- KMS link (preferred BYOK): 1 spike + 1 sprint to stabilize
- Ephemeral raw key upload w/ secure wipe: 2 sprints (security review + HSM changes)

Risks: legal/regulatory review for key escrow, auditability of purge, cross-region key routing.

I'll sync with Marcus on telemetry and Grace on evidence format to make sure acceptance criteria are solid.

-Karthik
Senior Staff Engineer, Infra

Attachment: kms-feasibility-notes.md

Thanks all — here's a pragmatic roadmap proposal to make ClearHealth productive quickly while managing long-term risk:

Sprint A (2 weeks):
- Deliver on-demand NDJSON export for audit events + signed export manifest (HSM-signed).
- Add retention presets (90d, 5y) surfaced via account API flag (no UI).
- Acceptance: ClearHealth can pull an export and verify manifest.

Sprint B (4 weeks):
- KMS link integration (preferred BYOK) — implement IAM role + test flow.
- Add export automation to snapshot prior to any purge.

Optional Sprint C (roadmap):
- Escrow workflow + ephemeral key upload support (requires legal & HSM work).

Action items:
- Ben: propose MAP and commercial milestone for POC (please loop Mallory).
- Karthik/Marcus: provide final ETA and block list by Thurs EOD so we can ship Sprint A next week.
- Naomi/Grace: confirm evidence artifacts are auditor-acceptable.

If that sequence works, we can deliver the POC-critical features without delaying the customer.

-Priya
Product Manager, Security Platform
